config.enabled.name: Turn off Green Rain
config.enabled.tooltip: Green Rain no longer comes. Takes effect from the next day; a Green Rain that's already happening finishes normally.
config.replace-with-rain.name: Normal rain instead
config.replace-with-rain.tooltip: On: the day Green Rain would have come gets normal rain, so your crops still get watered. Off: that day gets the normal random weather.
config.keep-first-year.name: Keep it in year 1
config.keep-first-year.tooltip: Keep Green Rain in the first year, so its one-time story moments (Gus's letter, the town gathering at the saloon) still happen.
calendar.host-only: Only the host can change this.
